StaffMember.title: StaffMember
StaffMember.description: Shared PPIO depot staff member with designation, competency, duty qualifications, and weekly rest day

serialNo.description: Staff serial number from PPIO sheet

competency.description: Special certification; POINTSMAN restricts assignment to Pointsman role slots

trainingDueDate.description: Optional ISO date YYYY-MM-DD when periodic technical training is due (empty string when none)

trainingCourse.description: Optional technical training course or module name

phoneNumber.description: Optional primary contact phone number for staff calling & messaging

secondaryPhoneNumber.description: Optional alternate/secondary contact phone number for staff calling & messaging

ShiftSlotAssignment.title: ShiftSlotAssignment
ShiftSlotAssignment.description: Approved and published personnel assignment for a specific date, shift, duty area, and slot index

slotIndex.description: Zero-based slot index within the duty area

isEmergencyOverride.description: Whether supervisor bypassed a conflict rule

approvedLocked.description: True once saved/approved by Supervisor so Storemate cannot alter

approvedByName.description: Supervisor who approved or published the assignment

DutyApprovalRequest.title: DutyApprovalRequest
DutyApprovalRequest.description: Storemate shift duty draft submitted for Supervisor approval before updating shared assignments

DutyDateLock.title: DutyDateLock
DutyDateLock.description: Lock marker indicating a duty date has been approved by Supervisor and cannot be altered by Storemate

LeaveRecord.title: LeaveRecord
LeaveRecord.description: Shared leave request/approval record; APPROVED excludes staff from shift availability

leaveType.description: Leave category (CL, LAP, LHAP, Special Leave, Technical Training)

status.description: Approval status; APPROVED excludes staff from shift availability

EmergencyOverrideLog.title: EmergencyOverrideLog
EmergencyOverrideLog.description: Shared audit log of manual emergency shift overrides

DepotUserProfile.title: DepotUserProfile
DepotUserProfile.description: User role assignment controlled by Admin (Vinod Chinthawar)

email.description: User email address (PII restricted to owner/Admin)

phoneNumber.description: Primary phone number entered during registration

secondaryPhoneNumber.description: Optional secondary phone number entered during registration

registered.description: True once the user has completed online account registration

updatedByUid.description: Admin UID who last updated role

UsernameClaim.title: UsernameClaim
UsernameClaim.description: Global online username reservation keyed by lowercase username to prevent duplicates

username.description: Lowercase unique username matching document ID

UserCredential.title: UserCredential
UserCredential.description: Owner-only salted PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 password hash used for online username/password login synced with Gmail

uid.description: Owner Firebase Auth UID matching document ID

RoleInvite.title: RoleInvite
RoleInvite.description: Admin-created role pre-assignment keyed by lowercase Google email so users automatically receive their role when signing in on another phone

email.description: Lowercase invited Google email matching document ID

updatedByUid.description: Admin UID who created or updated the invite

DepotSettings.title: DepotSettings
DepotSettings.description: Admin-managed shared depot settings such as Technician share options visibility

allowTechnicianShare.description: Whether Technicians can see Share WhatsApp and PDF options

showShunterForTechnicians.description: Whether Shunter slot is visible to Technicians in Duties

includeShunterInExport.description: Whether Shunter slot is included in WhatsApp and PDF exports

importantContactsInitialized.description: True once Admin has seeded the default Important Phone Numbers so deleted defaults never re-appear

rakesInitialized.description: True once default EMU/MEMU/Vande Bharat rake formations have been seeded so deleted defaults never re-appear

rakesSchemaVersion.description: Schema revision for seeded coach role formations (v2 = Conv EMU MC/TC/TC and MEMU DMC/TC1/TC2/TC3)

roleMenuAccess.description: Admin-managed per-role menu access matrix mapping role -> menu -> NONE | READ_ONLY | EDIT_WITH_APPROVAL | FULL_CONTROL

updatedByUid.description: Admin UID who last changed the setting

StaffLeaveAccount.title: StaffLeaveAccount
StaffLeaveAccount.description: Per-staff carry-forward LAP/LHAP opening balance, one-time Technician self-update flag, and Supervisor/Admin LAP correction approval state

baseYear.description: Reference calendar year for opening balances

lapOpeningBalance.description: Jan 1 LAP opening balance for baseYear

lhapOpeningBalance.description: Jan 1 LHAP opening balance for baseYear

lapSelfUpdated.description: True once staff member has used their one-time direct LAP & LHAP update

pendingLapBalance.description: Requested remaining LAP days awaiting Supervisor/Admin approval

pendingLhapBalance.description: Requested remaining LHAP days awaiting Supervisor/Admin approval

pendingLapYear.description: Year for pending leave balance correction

pendingLapStatus.description: Approval state of leave balance correction request

pendingLapReviewedByName.description: Supervisor/Admin who approved or rejected correction

DutyPermissionRecord.title: DutyPermissionRecord
DutyPermissionRecord.description: Supervisor, Admin, and ShiftIncharge duty relief permission specifying relief hours granted to a staff member

reason.description: Optional remarks or reason for permission

grantedByName.description: ShiftIncharge, Supervisor, or Admin display name

ImportantContact.title: ImportantContact
ImportantContact.description: Important depot control & station phone number visible to Shift Incharge, Supervisor, and Admin; managed exclusively by Admin

label.description: Control room or station desk label

category.description: Operational category such as Control, Signal / RRI, Station Master

RakeFormation.title: RakeFormation
RakeFormation.description: EMU, MEMU, Spare Unit, or Vande Bharat rake formation with ordered coach compositions

rakeName.description: Rake identifier such as 3-Ph EMU Rake 1 or Vande Bharat R-83

make.description: Optional manufacturer make such as ICF or RCF

tcasFitted.description: Whether TCAS / Kavach is fitted on the rake

startEnd.description: Leading end orientation label such as KZJ or SC

finishEnd.description: Trailing end orientation label such as SC or KZJ

remarks.description: Optional operational remarks such as coach swaps or BT Rake

coaches.description: Ordered list of 1..24 coach objects with position, coachNumber, coachType, altNumber, endTag

AppReleaseConfig.title: AppReleaseConfig
AppReleaseConfig.description: Admin-published OTA app release metadata pointing to a signed GitHub Releases HTTPS APK link

latestVersionCode.description: Latest published Android versionCode (0 when paused/unset)

minSupportedVersionCode.description: Devices below this versionCode must update before continuing

mandatory.description: When true, forces all older versions to update immediately

downloadUrl.description: Verified https:// GitHub Releases APK download URL

releaseNotes.description: Changelog / What's New summary for depot staff

sha256Checksum.description: Optional 64-char hex SHA-256 checksum for verification

publishedByUid.description: Admin UID who published the release

publishedByName.description: Admin display name who published the release

/depots/{depotId}/staff/{staffId}.description: Shared PPIO depot staff roster visible to all depot users

/depots/{depotId}/assignments/{assignmen.description: Shared Supervisor-approved daily shift assignments visible to everyone

/depots/{depotId}/dutyDrafts/{draftId}.description: Storemate shift duty drafts awaiting Supervisor approval

/depots/{depotId}/dutyLocks/{dutyDate}.description: Per-date approval lock preventing post-approval Storemate alterations

/depots/{depotId}/leaves/{leaveId}.description: Shared leave applications and Supervisor approvals

/depots/{depotId}/overrides/{overrideId}.description: Shared emergency manual override audit logs

/depots/{depotId}/userRoles/{targetUid}.description: Admin-managed user role and registration profile directory

/depots/{depotId}/usernames/{usernameKey.description: Unique lowercase username claims preventing duplicate registrations

/depots/{depotId}/userCredentials/{targe.description: Owner-only salted PBKDF2 password hashes for online username/password login synced with Gmail

/depots/{depotId}/roleInvites/{emailKey}.description: Admin-managed Google email role pre-assignments claimed automatically on cross-device Google Sign-In

/depots/{depotId}/settings/{settingId}.description: Shared depot feature toggles managed by Admin

/depots/{depotId}/leaveAccounts/{staffId.description: Staff LAP/LHAP carry-forward balances and Technician one-time update / Supervisor approval state

/depots/{depotId}/dutyPermissions/{permi.description: ShiftIncharge, Supervisor, and Admin duty relief permissions tracking hours relieved from duty

/depots/{depotId}/importantContacts/{con.description: Important depot phone numbers visible to ShiftIncharge, Supervisor, and Admin, and added/removed exclusively by Admin

/depots/{depotId}/rakes/{rakeId}.description: Shared EMU, MEMU, Spare Unit, and Vande Bharat rake formations viewable by all signed-in depot staff and managed by Admin, Supervisor, and ShiftIncharge

/depots/{depotId}/appRelease/{releaseId}.description: Admin-managed live OTA app release config (latest) readable by all signed-in depot users
